subject: Order Form: invoice routing, VAT evidence, and net terms clarifications
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acmesys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Order form clarifications — invoice routing & VAT evidence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending the draft order form last week. Procurement has a couple of asks before we can route to legal and finance on our side:

- Invoice recipient: our finance team requires invoices to be issued to Acme Systems Ltd (UK entity). Can you confirm Redwood will send invoices to billing@acmesys.com and include our VAT ID on the invoice?
- Net terms: the purchase order we raise will be Net45. We noticed the current order form shows Net30 — is Net45 acceptable?
- VAT / withholding: for UK customers we need a VAT certificate on file to validate zero-rating where applicable. Could you provide Redwood's VAT evidence or confirm whether Redwood will accept our certificate instead?

We are aiming to sign by end of next week if we can get alignment on these commercial routing items. Attaching our standard procurement checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
Sourcing Manager — Acme Systems
procurement@acmesys.com

Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acmesys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 15:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications — invoice routing & VAT evidence

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front:

- Invoice recipient: yes, we can route invoices to billing@acmesys.com and include Acme Systems Ltd + VAT ID on the invoice.
- Net terms: we can accommodate Net45 for this arrangement but will need finance approval for the first invoice (we typically require Net30 for new accounts).
- VAT evidence: Redwood will accept your VAT certificate for UK VAT purposes. We also attach our current order form with annotated commercial redlines for your review; Ben (billing) and Karthik (legal) are cc'd to confirm the operational steps.

Ben — can you confirm the Net45 exception process (first-invoice hold / credit check) and whether any PO fields we need to map?
Karthik — if there are any contract-level adjustments needed (MSA appendix for invoicing entity), please flag.

I'll coordinate turnaround — are you available for a 20-min call Monday to finalize routing?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: OrderForm_v1_redlines.pdf (pdf stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acmesys.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Sep 2028 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications — invoice routing & VAT evidence

Thanks Kimberly / Maria — quick ops note from billing:

- Net45 OK as an exception. Operationally we will: 1) require the first invoice to be paid Net30 or provide an approved credit term waiver; 2) add a comment on the invoice with the Acme PO number and the Remit-To = Acme Systems Ltd, billing@acmesys.com.
- For accounting we need the exact registered entity name and VAT number in the PO. Maria, can you paste the legal entity line exactly as it should appear on the invoice?
- VAT evidence: we can accept Acme's VAT certificate (PDF) and will retain it in our billing file. For cross-border EU transactions we also require a completed W-8/Certificate of VAT status equivalent — Karhtik, can you confirm required text for the MSA appendix?

I've attached a proposed small amendment to the order form (page 2) that adds an invoice routing clause and a Net45 waiver clause. This keeps the main MSA untouched and is designed to be signable by both parties.

Ben Carter
Director, Billing & Receivables, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: OrderForm_v1_billing_amendment.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acmesys.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications — invoice routing & VAT evidence

Hi Ben / Kimberly — thanks. Confirming the exact entity details below for invoice printing and PO creation:

Acme Systems Ltd
Registered address: 12 Broadwick St, London W1F 0DL, UK
VAT ID: GB999999973
PO contact / remit: billing@acmesys.com

We attach our VAT certificate (UK) and the PO template our finance team will use. We can accept the small amendment you proposed — I reviewed the OrderForm_v1_billing_amendment.pdf and it looks fine.

On Net45: our AP team prefers Net45 and will not push for pay-in-advance. If Redwood requires any credit info for the waiver, please let us know what you need and we'll get it to you this week.

I'm available Tuesday at 09:30 BST for the 20-min call if that works for your team.

Regards,
Maria Ortega
Sourcing Manager — Acme Systems

Attachments: Acme_VAT_Certificate_UK.pdf, Acme_PO_Template.docx (stubs)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@acmesys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Sep 2028 09:00:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Order form clarifications — invoice routing & VAT evidence

Maria — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the VAT cert. Next steps:

1) Ben will run the credit waiver and confirm whether we need any additional documentation (expected by EOD Monday).
2) Karthik — if you can draft the two-line MSA appendix referencing the invoice routing clause (as Ben's amendment shows) and the Net45 waiver language, we can exchange signatures.
3) Once legal confirms, I'll send a DocuSign envelope that includes: (a) the MSA appendix, (b) the amended order form, and (c) a final summary sheet mapping PO fields to invoice fields.

Proposed signing timeline: sign by 2028-09-27 so onboarding & provisioning can start Oct 1.

I created a DocuSign envelope and will wait to send it until you confirm the Net45 waiver bit is acceptable after Ben's check. Link (will send once we have final text): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?token=abc123

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Kimberly
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
